_comment: Solution-style tsconfig (files: []) — compiles nothing; the real build config is tsconfig.app.json. The compilerOptions.paths below exist ONLY so the shadcn CLI, which reads path aliases from the project-root tsconfig, resolves `@/*` to ./src/* and writes components to src/components/ui/ instead of a literal ./@/ directory. Keep this mapping in sync with tsconfig.app.json.
